info.name: CRM Sales Management API
info.description:
Backend API for the CRM Sales Management System.

**Quick start:** 1) `npm run seed` 2) run *Auth > Login* (the token is saved automatically) 3) set `managerId` / `executiveId` from *Users > List users* 4) walk the folders top to bottom.

**Auth:** JWT access token (15 min) sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (collection-level auth) or via the httpOnly `accessToken` cookie. Refresh token (7 days) lives in an httpOnly cookie.

**Success response:** `{ "success": true, "message": "...", "data": {...}, "pagination": {...} }` (pagination only on lists: currentPage, pageSize, totalRecords, totalPages)

**Error response:** `{ "success": false, "message": "...", "errors": [{ "field": "body.email", "message": "Invalid email address" }] }` (`errors` only for validation failures)

**Status codes:** 400 validation / invalid business rule, 401 not logged in or bad token, 403 role or ownership forbids it, 404 not found, 409 conflict (duplicate / already converted / closed deal), 429 rate limited, 500 unexpected.
